+"""Unit tests for risk.drawdown.max_drawdown (PL-03 step 3, spine: depth only)."""
+
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk.drawdown import max_drawdown
+from risk.types import Drawdown, Returns
+
+CONTRACTS = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "contracts"
+
+
+def _sample_returns() -> Returns:
+    data = json.loads((CONTRACTS / "risk.Returns" / "sample.json").read_text())
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=data["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(data["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(data["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _one_ticker(series: tuple[float, ...]) -> Returns:
+    dates = tuple(f"d{i}" for i in range(1, len(series) + 1))
+    return Returns(base_date="d0", dates=dates, tickers=("X",), values={"X": series})
+
+
+def test_sample_gives_the_drawdown_sample() -> None:
+    data = json.loads((CONTRACTS / "risk.Drawdown" / "sample.json").read_text())
+    result = max_drawdown(_sample_returns())
+    assert [d.ticker for d in result] == ["AAA", "BBB"]
+    for got, want in zip(result, data["drawdowns"], strict=True):
+        assert got.depth == pytest.approx(want["depth"], abs=1e-9)
+        assert (got.peak_date, got.trough_date) == (want["peak_date"], want["trough_date"])
+
+
+def test_hand_computed_depth_from_peak_to_trough() -> None:
+    # Wealth 1 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0.5 -> 1: worst fall is 2 -> 0.5, i.e. -75%.
+    up, down = math.log(2.0), -math.log(2.0)
+    (d,) = max_drawdown(_one_ticker((up, down, down, up)))
+    assert d == Drawdown("X", pytest.approx(-0.75), "d1", "d3")
+

+    (d,) = max_drawdown(_one_ticker((math.log(0.9),)))
+    assert d.depth == pytest.approx(-0.1)
+    assert (d.peak_date, d.trough_date) == ("d0", "d1")
+
+
+def test_tied_peaks_and_troughs_keep_the_first() -> None:
+    half = -math.log(2.0)
+    # Wealth 1 -> 0.5 -> 1 -> 0.5: two equal falls from equal peaks.
+    (d,) = max_drawdown(_one_ticker((half, -half, half)))
+    assert d.depth == pytest.approx(-0.5)
+    assert (d.peak_date, d.trough_date) == ("d0", "d1")
+
+

+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+

+
+from risk.types import Returns

+
+SAMPLE = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "contracts" / "risk.Returns" / "sample.json"
+
+
+def _sample_returns() -> Returns:
+    data = json.loads(SAMPLE.read_text())
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=data["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(data["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(data["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _one_ticker(series: tuple[float, ...]) -> Returns:
+    dates = tuple(f"d{i}" for i in range(1, len(series) + 1))
+    return Returns(base_date="d0", dates=dates, tickers=("X",), values={"X": series})
+
+
+def test_sample_is_aligned_and_none_until_window_earlier_returns() -> None:
+    returns = _sample_returns()
+    result = rolling_vol(returns, 2)
+    assert result.returns is returns
+    assert result.window == 2
+    assert result.annualized is False
+    assert set(result.values) == {"AAA", "BBB"}
+    for series in result.values.values():
+        assert len(series) == len(returns.dates)
+        assert series[:2] == (None, None)
+        assert all(v is not None and v > 0 for v in series[2:])
+
+
+def test_sample_first_value_is_stdev_of_first_two_returns() -> None:
+    result = rolling_vol(_sample_returns(), 2)
+    # |0.009950330853 - (-0.014962872677)| / sqrt(2)

+    assert result.values["X"][:2] == (None, None)
+    assert result.values["X"][2] == pytest.approx(math.sqrt(2))
+    assert result.values["X"][3] == pytest.approx(2.0)
+
